objective: Starting from the homepage, find and enter the vehicle configurator, proceed through the configuration steps, click the final completion control (a Summary, Continue, or equivalent control -- whatever label the site itself uses), and stop once the resulting page confirms the configuration is finished. Capture the journey taken along with GA4 and dataLayer evidence.

successCriteria.description: The vehicle configurator has been entered: configuration controls (e.g. trim, colour, options) are visible on the page.

The configuration process has been completed: the final completion control (for example a Summary or Continue button, or an equivalent control in the page's own language) was actually clicked, and the resulting page confirms the configuration is finished -- e.g. a summary of the completed build, or an explicit completion/confirmation state. Being on a right-looking page by itself is not enough; the completion control must have been the one clicked.
